# SprintA Copilot Instructions

Follow the repository rules in `AGENTS.md` and the product vocabulary in `CONTEXT.md`.

When editing frontend files, also follow `Frontend/AGENTS.md`. When editing backend files, also follow `Backend/AGENTS.md`.

Prioritize consistent responsive UI/UX, correct Scrum/Kanban semantics, end-to-end working features, first-user onboarding, real persisted data, security and regression coverage. Prefer the smallest complete solution and reuse existing code before creating abstractions.
